preparation.known_limits: Native solver loadability, coupled equilibrium and dynamic response are NOT_EVALUATED. Generic tanker RAOs lack qualified wind/current/drift coefficients. The inherited tanker is excluded from statics and requires equilibrium configuration. Transfer-hose properties are illustrative, with no manufacturer qualification. Whole-line extrema must cover the analysis stage; time and mesh sensitivity, pretension, offsets, anchor capacity, fatigue and tension-dependent hose limits require separate assessment. No environmental force or hawser load is inferred.
